```{r}
sample_1k_readr <- function(path) {
  # Read all columns as character to avoid parsing issues
  df <- read_csv(
    path,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    guess_max = 100000
  )


  n_take <- min(1000L, nrow(df)) 
  if (n_take == 0L) return(df[0, ]) 
  dplyr::slice_sample(df, n = n_take)
}

citibike_sample_12k <- map_dfr(file_paths, sample_1k_readr)
```

# Code for Map
```{r}
# --- Packages ---
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)
library(glue)
library(htmlwidgets)


in_csv   <- "/Users/machenchen/Desktop/STA-HW/p8105_final_project/Data/citibike_sample_12k.csv"
out_dir  <- "/Users/machenchen/Desktop/STA-HW/p8105_final_project/Data/maps_by_month"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

citibike <- read_csv(in_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Ensure a 'month' column exists (YYYYMM) ---
if (!"month" %in% names(citibike)) {
  # Try to parse started_at
  dt <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
    citibike$started_at,
    orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd H", "ymd",
               "Ymd HMS", "Ymd HM", "Ymd H", "Ymd")
  ))
  citibike$month <- format(dt, "%Y%m")
}

# Drop rows with unknown month (if any)
citibike <- citibike %>% filter(!is.na(month))

# Function to build one monthly map from your original logic ---
make_month_map <- function(df, month_label) {

  starts <- df %>%
    transmute(
      station_name = start_station_name,
      lat = as.numeric(start_lat),
      lng = as.numeric(start_lng)
    )

  ends <- df %>%
    transmute(
      station_name = end_station_name,
      lat = as.numeric(end_lat),
      lng = as.numeric(end_lng)
    )

  stations <- bind_rows(starts, ends) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lng), station_name != "")

  # Count frequency of each station
  station_freq <- stations %>%
    count(station_name, lat, lng, name = "freq", sort = TRUE)

  pink_blue <- colorRampPalette(c("#FF1493", "#8A2BE2", "#00008B"))
  pal <- colorNumeric(palette = pink_blue(100), domain = station_freq$freq)

  radius_scaled <- rescale(station_freq$freq, to = c(5, 15))

  # Build leaflet map
  m <- leaflet(station_freq) %>%
    addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
      radius = radius_scaled,
      color = ~pal(freq),
      fillColor = ~pal(freq),
      fillOpacity = 0.9, stroke = FALSE,
      label = ~paste0(station_name, " — ", freq, " trips")
    ) %>%
    addLegend(
      pal = pal, values = ~freq,
      title = glue("Station frequency ({month_label})"),
      opacity = 0.9, position = "bottomright"
    )

  # Save HTML for this month
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, glue("citibike_map_{month_label}.html"))
  saveWidget(m, file = out_file, selfcontained = TRUE)
  message("✓ Saved: ", out_file)
}

# create  maps
for (mm in sort(unique(citibike$month))) {
  df_mm <- filter(citibike, month == mm)
  make_month_map(df_mm, mm)
}

```

```{r}
library(readr)

    ended_at   = parse_date_time(ended_at,
                                 orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd H",

  )
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)

# Build paths for the 6 October CSVs 
oct_dir <- "/Users/machenchen/Desktop/STA-HW/p8105_final_project/Data/202410-citibike-tripdata"
oct_paths <- file.path(
  oct_dir,
  paste0("202410-citibike-tripdata_", 1:6, ".csv")
)

# read one file safely and sample 1000 rows
sample_1k <- function(path) {
  # read as character to avoid type conflicts across files
  df <- read_csv(
    path,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )
  n_take <- min(1000L, nrow(df))
  if (n_take == 0L) return(df[0, ])
  dplyr::slice_sample(df, n = n_take)
}

# sample 1000 from each of 6 files and combine
oct_sample6k <- map_dfr(oct_paths, sample_1k)

# remove rows with ANY NA
oct_clean <- oct_sample6k %>%
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))

#  parse datetimes and compute duration
oct_clean <- oct_clean %>%
  mutate(
    started_at = parse_date_time(
      started_at,
      orders = c("ymd HMS","ymd HM","ymd H","ymd",
                 "Ymd HMS","Ymd HM","Ymd H","Ymd")
    ),
    ended_at   = parse_date_time(
      ended_at,
      orders = c("ymd HMS","ymd HM","ymd H","ymd",
                 "Ymd HMS","Ymd HM","Ymd H","Ymd")
    ),
    duration = as.numeric(difftime(ended_at, started_at, units = "mins"))
  )


# filter
oct_filtered <- oct_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration), duration > 0, duration < 200)

# checking
summary(oct_filtered$duration)
nrow(oct_filtered)

# Save csv
write_csv(
  oct_filtered,
  "/Users/machenchen/Desktop/STA-HW/p8105_final_project/Data/october_2024_sample6k_clean.csv"
)
```

# Fitting model

```{r}
library(gbm)            # for gradient boosting
library(tidyverse)      # for data handling
merged <- merged |>
  mutate(
    member_casual = as.factor(member_casual),
    rideable_type = as.factor(rideable_type),
    weather_code  = as.factor(weather_code)
  )
merged
```

```{r}
str(merged$weather_code)
```



```{r}
# Model A: Multiple Linear Regression (baseline model)
model_lm <- lm(duration ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data  = merged)
summary (model_lm)
```

```{r}
# Reduced model
model_lm_0 <- lm(duration ~ temp_c + member_casual,
               data = merged)
summary(model_lm_0)
```


```{r}
levels(merged$member_casual)
levels(merged$rideable_type)
```

casual = 0, member = 1. classoc_bike = 0, electric_bike = 1.


```{r}
# Model B: Random Forest Regression (nonlinear)
library(randomForest)
model_rf <- randomForest::randomForest(
  duration ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data = merged
)
```

```{r}
# Reduced model for Model B
model_rf_0 <- randomForest::randomForest(
  duration ~ temp_c + member_casual, data = merged
)
```



```{r}
# Model C: Gradient Boosting (XGBoost or gbm)
model_gbm <- gbm::gbm(
  duration ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data = merged,
  distribution = "gaussian",
  n.trees = 3000, 
  interaction.depth = 4,
  shrinkage = 0.01,
  cv.folds = 5
)

```

```{r}
)
```


```{r}
# Checking MSE
set.seed(1)
train_index <- sample(nrow(merged), 0.8 * nrow(merged))
train <- merged[train_index, ]
test  <- merged[-train_index, ]

model_lm_0 <- lm(duration ~ temp_c + member_casual, data  = train)
model_rf_0 <- randomForest::randomForest(
  duration ~ temp_c + member_casual, data = train
)
model_gbm_0 <- gbm::gbm(
  duration ~ temp_c + member_casual, data = train,
  distribution = "gaussian",
  n.trees = 3000, 
  interaction.depth = 4,
  shrinkage = 0.01,
  cv.folds = 5
)

rmse <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
}

rmse_lm  <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_lm_0,  test))
rmse_rf  <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_rf_0,  test))
rmse_gbm <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_gbm_0, test, n.trees = 3000))

cbind(
  Model = c("LM", "Random Forest", "GBM"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse_lm, rmse_rf, rmse_gbm)
)
```
